summary: Goeland is a self-hosted tool that takes standard RSS or Atom web feeds and converts them into structured email digests. It runs as a lightweight containerized service, fetching updates on a schedule and formatting them for your inbox. This allows you to consolidate multiple subscriptions into fewer, periodic reading batches.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small teams who prefer managing their RSS consumption directly inside an email client rather than using a dedicated feed reader application.
watchOut: Project maintenance has slowed down recently, and with only a modest number of repository stars, you may encounter unresolved bugs or lack community support for advanced configurations.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, it typically requires persistent storage for configuration and state data, along with a reverse proxy to handle external access if exposed securely.
